title: Corollary
body_md:
If $f$ is convex on $[a,b]$, then
\begin{eqnarray}\label{9}
\hspace{-0.75cm}\frac{1}{m-1}\sum_{i=1}^{m-1} f\left(x_i^{(m)}\right)\leq
\frac{1}{b-a}\int _a^b f(t)dt\leq \frac{1}{n+1}\sum_{i=0}^
nf\left(x_i^{(n)}\right)\hspace{0.5cm} (m=2,3,\ldots;~n=1,2,\ldots),
\end{eqnarray}
which is a refinement and extension of Hermitt-Hadamard inequality (\ref{10}).\\
Both inequalities in (\ref{9}) are strict, if $f$ is strictly convex.
